parameters.name: AutoCreateRepo
parameters.description: Whether to automatically create a repository when an image is pushed.

parameters.name: DefaultRepoConfiguration
parameters.description: The default configuration for automatically created repositories.

parameters.name: DefaultRepoType
parameters.description:
The default type for automatically created repositories. This parameter applies only if `AutoCreateRepo` is set to `true`. Valid values:

- `PUBLIC`: a public repository

- `PRIVATE`: a private repository
